integrity: All primary-source dates and evaluated claims distinguished. Numerical checks supplement exact symbolic proofs. Broader publication priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Exact in the stationary independent two-Poisson-clock Brownian-medium model; no statement for coupled clocks, non-Poisson waits, finite-time experimental inference, or finite-sample confidence. Long-lag unit ratio is relative decay only; the absolute correlations vanish.
title: Two-clock diffusivity resetting has a sharp spatial-memory threshold
